tonight.headline: Still nothing to set: Saturday's reports left every starter clear
body: Bad news first: Garrett Wilson is OUT (concussion), and Carson Wentz — not Kyler Murray — throws to Jefferson on Monday; Minnesota made it official on Saturday's game-status report. Both were known before ESPN set its numbers.

AVIATO lead 8.9 to 5.58 after Thursday; ESPN projects 120.2 to 124.4, a 48% chance. Saturday added two things: Buffalo cleared Allen and Kincaid for Monday, and the Saints waived Kendre Miller, lifting Kamara to 12.3 — still 0.9 behind Allgeier, a coin flip that stays with the projection. Nothing to do before Sunday's inactives.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Talla Metralla start Burrow, Jonathan Taylor (no team near the Colts' price, PFR Sat), Swift, Henry and Golden. Your Monday pair, Allen and Jefferson with Wentz throwing, are the last word; both cleared Saturday's reports.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Sunday starter is inactive at the 90-minute list and the bench is not used — the only way "nothing to do" turns wrong. No starter carries a designation after Saturday.

worthALook.name: Denzel Boston
worthALook.lead: Cut by Bok-aneers this afternoon, healthy — decide on Tuesday, before his claim clears Wed 02:00.

case.label: The player
case.body: Opportunity 12.0 then 16.5 in Weeks 7-8 against Metcalf's 9.0 (archive), 10.9 a game. His calf cleared: full practice, off the report, plays Sunday (USA Today/Yahoo 6 Nov 20:04Z; NBC 6 Nov). Bok-aneers dropped him at 18:14Z for Jordyn Tyson; no injury or demotion found.

case.label: The quarterback
case.body: Deshaun Watson entered the concussion protocol on 4 Nov and is questionable; Shedeur Sanders is in line to start against New Orleans (AP 4 Nov). An unsettled passer is the honest risk.

case.label: Why not today
case.body: On waivers until Wed 11 Nov 08:00Z (02:00 CDMX). Every unlockable seat has a reason: Metcalf's claim thesis runs to Week 10 and has not tripped; Etienne's owner thesis runs to Week 11; Kamara just inherited Miller's work; Wilson is a 98%-owned WR1 with a concussion. Chem priority resets weekly, so a claim costs nothing lasting — the question is only the drop.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday's 16:00 run: claim if Boston draws 7+ targets Sunday with whoever starts at QB and Etienne's practice window is still unopened — Etienne would then be the drop, with his thesis addressed on the record. Pass if Boston draws under 5.
